                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Given (a2 + b2) ÷ 2ab = 3. Dividing numerator and denominator by ab, we get: (a/b + b/a) ÷ 2 = 3 ⇒ a/b + b/a = 6.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Let a/b = x, then x + 1/x = 6. Solving for the larger root, x = 3 + 2√2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The required ratio is a : (a + b), which is equivalent to x : (x + 1).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Ratio = (3 + 2√2) : (4 + 2√2). Multiplying both terms by (√2 − 1) gives (√2 + 1) : 2√2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ The correct answer is (√2 + 1) : 2√2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Given: (a2 + b2) / 2ab = 3 / 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Using Componendo and Dividendo:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ (a2 + b2 + 2ab) / (a2 + b2 − 2ab) = (3 + 1) / (3 − 1)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ (a + b)2 / (a − b)2 = 4 / 2 = 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ (a + b) / (a − b) = √2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ a + b = √2a − √2b

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ b(1 + √2) = a(√2 − 1)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ a/b = (√2 + 1) / (√2 − 1)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Rationalizing the denominator for a/b:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ a/b = [(√2 + 1)(√2 + 1)] / [(√2 − 1)(√2 + 1)] = (2 + 1 + 2√2) / (2 − 1) = 3 + 2√2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Calculating the ratio a : (a + b):

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ a / (a + b) = (3 + 2√2) / (4 + 2√2)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                To simplify, multiply numerator and denominator by (√2 − 1):

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ Num = (3 + 2√2)(√2 − 1) = 3√2 − 3 + 4 − 2√2 = √2 + 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ Denom = (4 + 2√2)(√2 − 1) = 4√2 − 4 + 4 − 2√2 = 2√2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ Ratio = (√2 + 1) / 2√2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ The correct answer is (√2 + 1) : 2√2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Componendo and Dividendo Rule

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                If a/b = c/d, then (a + b) / (a − b) = (c + d) / (c − d). This property is very useful for solving equations involving fractions and powers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Quadratic Formula

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                For an equation ax2 + bx + c = 0, the roots are given by x = [−b ± √(b2 − 4ac)] / 2a. The discriminant (D = b2 − 4ac) determines the nature of the roots.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Rationalization

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                To rationalize a denominator like (x + √y), multiply both numerator and denominator by its conjugate (x − √y) to eliminate the radical term from the denominator. Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                माना a/b = x, तो x + 1/x = 6। बड़े मूल के लिए हल करने पर, x = 3 + 2√2।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                अभीष्ट अनुपात a : (a + b) है, जो x : (x + 1) के बराबर है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                अनुपात = (3 + 2√2) : (4 + 2√2)। दोनों पदों को (√2 − 1) से गुणा करने पर (√2 + 1) : 2√2 प्राप्त होता है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ सही उत्तर (√2 + 1) : 2√2 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Componendo and Dividendo का उ", "te": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ఇవ్వబడింది:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \\(\\frac{a^2+b^2}{2ab}=3\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ఉపయోగించిన భావన:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                (1) \\(\\frac{a+b}{a-b}\\)  కి కాంపోనెండో మరియు డివిడెండో నియమం

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{(a+b)+(a-b)}{(a+b)-(a-b)}=\\frac{a}{b}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                (2) (a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                (3) (a - b)2 = a2 + b2 - 2ab

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                గణన:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ప్రశ్న ప్రకారం,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a^2+b^2}{2ab}=3\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 కాంపోనెండో మరియు డివిడెండో నియమాన్ని వర్తింపజేయగా:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a^2+b^2+2ab}{a^2+b^2-2ab}=\\frac{3+1}{3-1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{(a+b)^2}{(a-b)^2}=\\frac{4}{2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{(a+b)^2}{(a-b)^2}=\\frac{2}{1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                సమీకరణానికి ఇరువైపులా వర్గమూలం చేయగా,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{(a+b)}{(a-b)}=\\frac{√ 2}{1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                కాంపోనెండో మరియు డివిడెండో నియమాన్ని మళ్ళీ వర్తింపజేయగా:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{(a+b)+(a-b)}{(a+b)-(a-b)}=\\frac{√ 2 + 1}{√ 2-1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{2a}{2b}=\\frac{√ 2 + 1}{√ 2-1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a}{b}=\\frac{√ 2 + 1}{√ 2-1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ఇప్పుడు, 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a యొక్క విలువ = (√2 + 1)k

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                b యొక్క విలువ = (√2 - 1)k

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ఇప్పుడు, అవసరమైన సమాసంలో సంబంధిత చరరాశి విలువలను ప్రతిక్షేపించగా,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a}{a+b}\\) = \\(\\frac{(\\sqrt 2 + 1)k}{(\\sqrt 2 + 1)k + (\\sqrt 2 - 1)k}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a}{a+b}\\) = \\(\\frac{\\sqrt 2 + 1}{\\sqrt 2 + 1 + \\sqrt 2 - 1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a}{a+b}\\) = \\(\\frac{\\sqrt 2 + 1}{2\\sqrt 2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ అవసరమైన ఫలితం \\({\\sqrt 2 + 1} : {2\\sqrt 2}\\).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                समीकरणाच्या दोन्ही बाजूंचे वर्गमूळ घ्या.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{(a+b)}{(a-b)}=\\frac{√ 2}{1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                आता,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                b चे मूल्य = (√2 - 1)k 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                आता, संबंधित चलाचे मूल्य आवश्यक पदावलीमध्ये बदला.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a}{a+b}\\) = \\(\\frac{(\\sqrt 2 + 1)k}{(\\sqrt 2 + 1)k + (\\sqrt 2 - 1)k}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a}{a+b}\\) = \\(\\frac{\\sqrt 2 + 1}{\\sqrt 2 + 1 + \\sqrt 2 - 1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                গণনা:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                প্রশ্নানুযায়ী,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a^2+b^2}{2ab}=3\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                অনুপাত ও সমানুপাত নিয়ম প্রয়োগ ক'রে পাই:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a^2+b^2+2ab}{a^2+b^2-2ab}=\\frac{3+1}{3-1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{(a+b)^2}{(a-b)^2}=\\frac{4}{2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{(a+b)^2}{(a-b)^2}=\\frac{2}{1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                সমীকরণের উভয় পাশে বর্গমূল ক'রে পাই:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{(a+b)}{(a-b)}=\\frac{√ 2}{1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                আবার অনুপাত ও সমানুপাত নিয়ম প্রয়োগ ক'রে পাই:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{(a+b)+(a-b)}{(a+b)-(a-b)}=\\frac{√ 2 + 1}{√ 2-1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{2a}{2b}=\\frac{√ 2 + 1}{√ 2-1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a}{b}=\\frac{√ 2 + 1}{√ 2-1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                এখন, 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a এর মান = (√2 + 1)k

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                b এর মান = (√2 - 1)k

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                এখন, প্রয়োজনীয় রাশিতে সংশ্লিষ্ট চলকের মান প্রতিস্থাপন করুন।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a}{a+b}\\) = \\(\\frac{(\\sqrt 2 + 1)k}{(\\sqrt 2 + 1)k + (\\sqrt 2 - 1)k}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a}{a+b}\\) = \\(\\frac{\\sqrt 2 + 1}{\\sqrt 2 + 1 + \\sqrt 2 - 1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a}{a+b}\\) = \\(\\frac{\\sqrt 2 + 1}{2\\sqrt 2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ নির্ণেয় উত্তর হল​ \\({\\sqrt 2 + 1} : {2\\sqrt 2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                നൽകിയിരിക്കുന്നത്:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                (1)  \\(\\frac{a+b}{a-b}\\) നുള്ള കംപോണെന്റോ ഡിവിഡന്റോ നിയമം 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{(a+b)+(a-b)}{(a+b)-(a-b)}=\\frac{a}{b}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                കണക്കുകൂട്ടൽ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ചോദ്യം അനുസരിച്ച്,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a^2+b^2}{2ab}=3\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                കംപോണെന്റോ ഡിവിഡന്റോ നിയമം പ്രയോഗിക്കുമ്പോൾ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a^2+b^2+2ab}{a^2+b^2-2ab}=\\frac{3+1}{3-1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{(a+b)^2}{(a-b)^2}=\\frac{4}{2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{(a+b)^2}{(a-b)^2}=\\frac{2}{1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                സമവാക്യത്തിന്റെ ഇരുവശത്തും വർഗ്ഗമൂലമെടുക്കുക.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{(a+b)}{(a-b)}=\\frac{√ 2}{1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                വീണ്ടും കംപോണെന്റോ ഡിവിഡന്റോ നിയമം പ്രയോഗിക്കുമ്പോൾ::

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{(a+b)+(a-b)}{(a+b)-(a-b)}=\\frac{√ 2 + 1}{√ 2-1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{2a}{2b}=\\frac{√ 2 + 1}{√ 2-1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a}{b}=\\frac{√ 2 + 1}{√ 2-1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ഇപ്പോൾ, 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a യുടെ മൂല്യം = (√2 + 1)k

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                b യുടെ മൂല്യം = (√2 - 1)k

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ഇപ്പോൾ, ആവശ്യമായ പദപ്രയോഗത്തിൽ, അതത് ചരത്തിന്റെ  മൂല്യം മാറ്റിസ്ഥാപിക്കുക.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a}{a+b}\\) = \\(\\frac{(\\sqrt 2 + 1)k}{(\\sqrt 2 + 1)k + (\\sqrt 2 - 1)k}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a}{a+b}\\) = \\(\\frac{\\sqrt 2 + 1}{\\sqrt 2 + 1 + \\sqrt 2 - 1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a}{a+b}\\) = \\(\\frac{\\sqrt 2 + 1}{2\\sqrt 2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ ആവശ്യമായ ഫലമാണ് \\({\\sqrt 2 + 1} : {2\\sqrt 2}\\).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ઉપયોગમાં લેવાયેલ ખ્યાલ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                (1) \\(\\frac{a+b}{a-b}\\) માટે યોગ અને વિયોગનું નિયમ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ગણતરી:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                પ્રશ્ન અનુસાર,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a^2+b^2}{2ab}=3\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                યોગ અને વિયોગનું નિયમ લગાવો:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a^2+b^2+2ab}{a^2+b^2-2ab}=\\frac{3+1}{3-1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{(a+b)^2}{(a-b)^2}=\\frac{4}{2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{(a+b)^2}{(a-b)^2}=\\frac{2}{1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                સમીકરણની બંને બાજુ વર્ગમૂળ લો.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{(a+b)}{(a-b)}=\\frac{√ 2}{1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ફરીથી યોગ અને વિયોગનું નિયમ લગાવો:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a}{b}=\\frac{√ 2 + 1}{√ 2-1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                હવે,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a નું મૂલ્ય = (√2 + 1)k

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                b નું મૂલ્ય = (√2 - 1)k

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                હવે, જરૂરી અભિવ્યક્તિમાં સંબંધિત ચલનું મૂલ્ય બદલો.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a}{a+b}\\) = \\(\\frac{(\\sqrt 2 + 1)k}{(\\sqrt 2 + 1)k + (\\sqrt 2 - 1)k}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a}{a+b}\\) = \\(\\frac{\\sqrt 2 + 1}{\\sqrt 2 + 1 + \\sqrt 2 - 1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\frac{a}{a+b}\\) = \\(\\frac{\\sqrt 2 + 1}{2\\sqrt 2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ જરૂરી પરિણામ \\({\\sqrt 2 + 1} : {2\\sqrt 2}\\) છે.
