                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          முழு பயணத்தில் காரின் சராசரி வேகம் மணிக்கு 16 கிமீ.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          v = பயணத்தின் இரண்டாம் பாதிக்கான வேகம்

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          \n", "or": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                          Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                          ଦୁଇଟି ସମାନ ଦୂରତା ପାଇଁ, ହାରାହାରି ବେଗ = (2 × v1 × v2) ÷ (v1 + v2)

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 16 = (2 × 40 × v2) ÷ (40 + v2)

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          ଦିଆଯାଇଛି:

                                                                                                                                                                          ସମଗ୍ର ଯାତ୍ରାର ହାରାହାରି ବେଗ", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                          Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                          ਦੋ ਬਰਾਬਰ ਦੂਰੀਆਂ ਲਈ, ਔਸਤ ਗਤੀ = (2 × v1 × v2) ÷ (v1 + v2)

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ ਔਸਤ ਗਤੀ = 16 km/hr ਅਤੇ v1 = 40 km/hr।

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 16 = (2 × 40 × v2) ÷ (40 + v2)

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 16 × (40 + v2) = 80v2

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 640 + 16v2 = 80v2 ⇒ 64v2 = 640 ⇒ v2 = 10

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ ਸਹੀ ਉੱਤਰ 10 km/hr ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ:

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ਪੂਰੀ ਯਾਤਰਾ ਦੀ ਔਸਤ ਗਤੀ = 16 km/hr

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ਪਹਿਲੇ ਅੱਧ ਲਈ ਗਤੀ (v1) = 40 km/hr

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ਮੰਨ ਲਓ ਦੂਜੇ ਅੱਧ ਲਈ ਗਤੀ v2 km/hr ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ਮੰਨ ਲਓ ਕੁੱਲ ਦੂਰੀ 2d ਹੈ। ਫਿਰ ਹਰੇਕ ਅੱਧ ਦੀ ਦੂਰੀ d ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਫਾਰਮੂਲਾ:

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ਔਸਤ ਗਤੀ = ਕੁੱਲ ਦੂਰੀ ÷ ਕੁੱਲ ਸਮਾਂ

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ਗਣਨਾਵਾਂ:

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ ਕੁੱਲ ਸਮਾਂ = ਪਹਿਲੇ ਅੱਧ ਲਈ ਸਮਾਂ + ਦੂਜੇ ਅੱਧ ਲਈ ਸਮਾਂ

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ ਕੁੱਲ ਸਮਾਂ = (d ÷ 40) + (d ÷ v2)

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ ਔਸਤ ਗਤੀ = 2d ÷ [(d ÷ 40) + (d ÷ v2)]

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 16 = 2d ÷ [d × (1/40 + 1/v2)]

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 16 = 2 ÷ (1/40 + 1/v2)

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 8 = 1 ÷ (1/40 + 1/v2)

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 1/40 + 1/v2 = 1/8

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 1/v2 = 1/8 − 1/40

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 1/v2 = (5 − 1) ÷ 40

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 1/v2 = 4/40

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 1/v2 = 1/10

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ v2 = 10 km/hr

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ ਸਹੀ ਉੱਤਰ 10 km/hr ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ਵੱਖ-ਵੱਖ ਦੂਰੀਆਂ ਲਈ ਔਸਤ ਗਤੀ

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ਜਦੋਂ ਕੋਈ ਵਸਤੂ ਵੱਖ-ਵੱਖ ਦੂਰੀਆਂ d1, d2, d3... ਨੂੰ ਕ੍ਰਮਵਾਰ ਗਤੀ v1, v2, v3... ਨਾਲ ਤੈਅ ਕਰਦੀ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਔਸਤ ਗਤੀ = (d1 + d2 + d3...) ÷ (t1 + t2 + t3...).

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ਤਿੰਨ ਬਰਾਬਰ ਦੂਰੀਆਂ ਲਈ ਔਸਤ ਗਤੀ

                                                                                                                                                                          ਜਦੋਂ ਇੱਕ ਯਾਤਰਾ ਨੂੰ ਤਿੰਨ ਬਰਾਬਰ ਹਿੱਸਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੰਡਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਜੋ x, y, ਅਤੇ z ਗਤੀ ਨਾਲ ਤੈਅ ਕੀਤੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਤਾਂ ਔਸਤ ਗਤੀ = (3xyz) ÷ (xy + yz + zx)।

{"prompt": "4", "value": "40"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                          Ratio of efficiency between Sudhir and Aarav = 4.5 : 1 → 9 : 2

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Total efficiency of both working together = 9 + 2 = 11 units/day

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Total Work = Total Efficiency × Time = 11 × 8 = 88 units

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Time taken by Aarav alone = Total Work ÷ Aarav's Efficiency = 88 ÷ 2 = 44 days

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 44 days.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Sudhir's efficiency is 4.5 times that of Aarav.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Time taken by both to complete the work = 8 days.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Work = Efficiency × Time

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Individual Time = Total Work ÷ Individual Efficiency

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n
                                                                                                                                                                          PersonDaysTotal WorkEfficiency
                                                                                                                                                                          Sudhir9.77889
                                                                                                                                                                          Aarav442
                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Let the efficiency of Aarav be 2 units/day.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Then, the efficiency of Sudhir = 4.5 × 2 = 9 units/day.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Combined efficiency of Sudhir + Aarav = 9 + 2 = 11 units/day.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Total work to be completed = 11 units/day × 8 days = 88 units.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Time taken by Aarav alone = 88 units ÷ 2 units/day = 44 days.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 44 days.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Efficiency-Time Relationship

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Efficiency is inversely proportional to time. If person A is n times more efficient than B, A will take 1/n of the time taken by B.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Combined Work Formula

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          If two people with efficiencies E1 and E2 work together for D days, the total work is (E1 + E2) × D.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Work and Wages

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Wages are generally distributed based on the ratio of work done, which is the product of efficiency and the time for which they worked. Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                          सुधीर और आरव के बीच क्षमता का अनुपात = 4.5 : 1 → 9 : 2

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          दोनों की एक साथ कार्य करने की कुल क्षमता = 9 + 2 = 11 इकाई/दिन

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          कुल कार्य = कुल क्षमता × समय = 11 × 8 = 88 इकाई

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          अकेले आरव द्वारा लिया गया समय = कुल कार्य ÷ आरव की क्षमता = 88 ÷ 2 = 44 दिन

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 44 दिन है।

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ सुधीर की क्षमता, आरव की क्षमता की 4.5 गुना है।

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ दोनों द्वारा कार्य पूरा करने में लिया गया समय = 8 दिन।

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ कार्य = क्षमता × समय

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ व्यक्तिगत समय = कुल कार्य ÷ व्यक्तिगत क्षमता

                                                                                                                                                                          \nఇవ్వబడినది:

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          ఆరవ్‌ కంటే సుధీర్‌ 4.5 రెట్లు సామర్థ్యం కలిగి ఉన్నాడు.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          వారు ఒక పనిని 8 రోజుల్లో పూర్తి చేయగలరు.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          ఉపయోగించిన కాన్సెప్ట్:

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          మొత్తం పని = కార్మికుల సమర్థవంతమైన సామర్థ్యం × వారు తీసుకున్న సమయం

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          గణన:

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          ఆరవ్ యొక్క సామర్థ్యం A అనుకొనుము.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          కాబట్టి, సుధీర్ సామర్థ్యం = 4.5 × A = 4.5A

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          ప్రభావవంతమైన సామర్థ్యం = 4.5A + A = 5.5A

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          మొత్తం పని = 5.5A × 8

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 44A

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          ఇప్పుడు,

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          ఆరవ్ మాత్రమే పనిని పూర్తి చేయడానికి తీసుకునే సమయం = 44A/A

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 44 రోజులు

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ ఆరవ్ అదే పనిని ఒంటరిగా చేయడానికి 44 రోజులు పడుతుంది.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          ते एक काम 8 दिवसात पूर्ण करू शकतात.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          वापरलेली संकल्पना:

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          एकूण काम = कामगारांची प्रभावी कार्यक्षमता × त्यांनी घेतलेला वेळ

"value": "30"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "45"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                          Number of diagonals in a polygon with n sides = n(n − 3) ÷ 2

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          For a pentadecagon, the number of sides n = 15.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Substituting n = 15 in the formula:

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Diagonals = 15 × (15 − 3) ÷ 2 = 15 × 12 ÷ 2

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Diagonals = 15 × 6 = 90

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 90.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Given: The polygon is a pentadecagon, which means it has 15 sides (n = 15).

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Formula Used: Total number of diagonals = n(n − 3)⁄2

                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ In any polygon, the total number of lines that can be drawn joining n vertices is nC2.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Out of these lines, n lines are the sides of the polygon.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Diagonals = Total lines − Number of sides

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Diagonals = [n(n − 1) ÷ 2] − n

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Diagonals = [15 × 14 ÷ 2] − 15

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Diagonals = [15 × 7] − 15

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Diagonals = 105 − 15

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Diagonals = 90

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 90.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Sum of Interior Angles

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          The sum of all interior angles of an n-sided polygon is given by (n − 2) × 180°.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Sum of Exterior Angles

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          For any convex polygon, the sum of all its exterior angles is always constant at 360°.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Regular Polygon Angles

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Each interior angle of a regular n-sided polygon = [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n, and each exterior angle = 360° ÷ n. Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                          n भुजाओं वाले एक बहुभुज में विकर्णों की संख्या = n(n − 3) ÷ 2

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          एक पेंटाडेकागन (pentadecagon) के लिए, भुजाओं की संख्या n = 15 है।

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          सूत्र में n = 15 रखने पर:

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          विकर्ण = 15 × (15 − 3) ÷ 2 = 15 × 12 ÷ 2

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          विकर्ण = 15 × 6 = 90

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 90 है।

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है: बहुभुज एक पेंटाडेकागन (pentadecagon) है, जिसका अर्थ है कि इसमें 15 भुजाएँ हैं (n = 15)।

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र: विकर्णों की कुल संख्या = n(n − 3)⁄2

                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ किसी भी बहुभुज में, n शीर्षों को जोड़कर खींची जा सकने वाली रेखाओं की कुल संख्या nC2 होती है।

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ इन रेखाओं में से, n रेखाएँ बहुभुज की भुजाएँ हैं।

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ विकर्ण = कुल रेखाएँ − भुजाओं की संख्या

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ विकर्ण = [n(n − 1) ÷ 2] − n

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ विकर्ण = [15 × 14 ÷ 2] − 15

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ विकर्ण = [15 × 7] − 15

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ विकर्ण = 105 − 15

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ विकर्ण = 90

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 90 है।

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          आंतरिक कोणों का योग

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          n-भुजाओं वाले बहुभुज के सभी आंतरिक कोणों का योग (n − 2) × 180° द्वारा दिया जाता है।

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          बाह्य कोणों का योग

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          किसी भी उत्तल बहुभुज के लिए, इसके सभी बाह्य कोणों का योग हमेशा 360° पर स्थिर रहता है।

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          नियमित बहुभुज कोण

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          एक नियमित n-भुजाओं वाले बहुभुज का प्रत्येक आंतरिक कोण = [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n, और प्रत्येक बाह्य कोण = 360° ÷ n होता है।

                                                                                                                                                                          In any quadratic equation ax2 + bx + c = 0, the Sum of Roots is given by the formula −b/a.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          For the equation x2 − 4x + k = 0, the coefficients are a = 1 and b = −4.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Sum of roots = −(−4)/1 = 4.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Since one root is 3, let the other root be x. Then, 3 + x = 4.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Solving for x: x = 4 − 3 = 1.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is x = 1.

                                                                                                                                                                          1. ଏକ ପେଣ୍ଟାଡେକାଗନ୍ ର 15 ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱ ଅଛି |

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          2. ବହୁଭୁଜ ର ଡାଇଗୋନାଲ୍ ସଂଖ୍ୟା = n (n - 3) / 2  (ଯେଉଁଠାରେ  n = ବହୁଭାଗର ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱ ସଂଖ୍ୟା) |

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          ଗଣନା:

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ, ପେଣ୍ଟାଡେକାଗନ୍ ର ଡାଇଗୋନାଲ୍ ସଂଖ୍ୟା |

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 15(15 - 3) ÷ 2

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 90

                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ ଏକ ପେଣ୍ଟାଡେକାଗନ୍ରେ 90 ଟି ଡାଇଗୋନାଲ୍ ଅଛି |

{"prompt": "3", "value": "16 : 45"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "3 : 5"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                          Equate the coefficients: (2/3) × y = (8/15) × z

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Cross-multiply to find the ratio y : z directly.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          y : z = (8/15) ÷ (2/3) = (8/15) × (3/2) = 4/5

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 4 : 5.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          (2/3) × y = (8/15) × z

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y / z = (8 / 15) / (2 / 3)

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y / z = (8 / 15) × (3 / 2)

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y / z = (8 × 3) / (15 × 2)

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y / z = 24 / 30

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y / z = 4 / 5

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y : z = 4 : 5

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 4 : 5.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Ratio of Fractions

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          To find the ratio a : b when ma = nb, the ratio is always a/b = n/m.

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Inverse Proportion

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          If two quantities are equated with different coefficients, their individual values are in the inverse ratio of those coefficients. Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                          गुणांकों को बराबर करें: (2/3) × y = (8/15) × z

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          सीधे अनुपात y : z ज्ञात करने के लिए तिर्यक-गुणा (Cross-multiply) करें।

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          y : z = (8/15) ÷ (2/3) = (8/15) × (3/2) = 4/5

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 4 : 5 है।

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          (2/3) × y = (8/15) × z

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y / z = (8 / 15) / (2 / 3)

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y / z = (8 / 15) × (3 / 2)

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y / z = (8 × 3) / (15 × 2)

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y / z = 24 / 30

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y / z = 4 / 5

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y : z = 4 : 5

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 4 : 5 है।

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          भिन्नों का अनुपात

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          जब ma = nb हो, तो अनुपात a : b ज्ञात करने के लिए, अनुपात हमेशा a/b = n/m होता है।

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          व्युत्क्रमानुपात (Inverse Proportion)

                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                          यदि दो राशियों को अलग-अलग गुणांकों के साथ बराबर किया जाता है, तो उनके व्यक्तिगत मान उन गुणांकों के व्युत्क्रम अनुपात में होते हैं।
